value.name: administrator meets Asha
value.description: A soft-spoken administrator finally comes out and leads Asha back to a small office.
evidence: The administrator came out eventually, a soft-spoken woman with a lanyard and a folder, and walked Asha back to a small office

value.name: records are presented
value.description: Asha finds the requested records already half-assembled on the desk in the office.
evidence: where the requested records were already half-assembled on the desk

value.name: Asha reviews medical records
value.description: Asha reads the nursing notes and medication logs, learning the implications of her father's discharge addendum.
evidence: Asha read the nursing notes first, then the medication logs
by the time she had finished the third page she understood that the discharge addendum was less a question than a notice

value.name: father flagged for transfer
value.description: Asha realizes her father has been flagged for transfer to a higher level of care that his facility and insurance cannot fully support.
evidence: her father had been flagged for transfer to a higher level of care, the kind his current facility could not provide and the kind his insurance would not fully cover

value.name: administrator presents facility list
value.description: The administrator gives Asha a printed list of accepting facilities with monthly rates and says the family must choose by Friday.
evidence: The administrator slid a printed sheet across the desk—a list of accepting facilities within ninety miles, with monthly rates beside each name in small careful type—and said the family would need to choose by Friday.

value.name: Asha confronts costs
value.description: Asha studies the listed prices and feels overwhelmed by the financial burden of the available facilities.
evidence: Asha looked at the numbers and felt the room narrow
None of them, at the rates listed, were affordable on her income alone

value.name: Asha notes nearby options
value.description: Asha notices that two facilities are near her Philadelphia apartment, one is in northern Delaware, and the rest are in unfamiliar Pennsylvania towns.
evidence: Two of the names were within an hour of her own apartment in Philadelphia; one was in northern Delaware; the rest were in Pennsylvania towns she had never been to.

value.name: Asha identifies cheapest option near Daniel
value.description: Asha realizes the closest facility to her brother Daniel is also the cheapest, which deeply affects her emotionally.
evidence: the closest one to Daniel—her brother Daniel, not Lucia's—was the cheapest by a margin that made her chest tighten

value.name: Asha requests to see father
value.description: Before leaving, Asha asks to see her father.
evidence: She asked to see her father before she left.

value.name: administrator allows brief visit
value.description: The administrator hesitates but agrees to let Asha see her father briefly because he is sleeping and they do not want to wake him.
evidence: The administrator hesitated, then said yes, but only briefly; he was sleeping, and they preferred not to wake him this late in the afternoon.

value.name: administrator escorts Asha to father
value.description: The administrator leads Asha down the corridor toward her father's room.
evidence: The administrator led her down a corridor that smelled faintly of warmed food and disinfectant
